metrics.structure: total relief times how evenly it is spread over the scales: one number for 'has structure'
metrics.relief_meso: relief between grain and a quarter of the sheet's radius: folds, bumps
metrics.relief_macro: relief from a quarter of the sheet's radius, and what is left of the shape: lobes, the body
metrics.relief_patchiness: how unevenly the fine relief is spread over 32 regions (0: the same everywhere)
metrics.growth_unevenness: how unevenly the young cells are spread over the regions (0: even growth)
metrics.reach: how far the farthest cells are from the centre, over the radius of gyration (1: sphere)
metrics.thickness_p50: median thickness through the form, over the radius of gyration (2: sphere)
metrics.buried_fraction: share of the cells that face another part of the form nearby
metrics.area_ratio: area over that of a sphere with the same volume (1: sphere)
